spec_references: ## Statements: positive supported-statement list includes Return and Match statement, but does not include named worker declarations or worker message passing.
## Expressions: "[Wait action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wait-action)" is supported; worker send and receive actions are not listed.
reason: The case asserts nil-return behavior inside named workers and requires a message exchange between w1 and w2. Named workers and worker send/receive actions are outside the subset's positive lists, so the whole case is a feature even though ordinary nil returns and wait actions are supported.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations: worker w1 and worker w2
Worker message send hello -> w2 and receive <- w1
test_design_notes: testPrintInWorkers is called from main and asserts Hello, a blank nil output, and Ballerina after worker communication; this is executable asserted behavior.
